## Batch 65 authored

The inspected frame-projection supplier did not establish shear symmetry, trace-freeness, or norm positivity. I added [lem-tgr-spatial-shear-properties](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/lem-tgr-spatial-shear-properties.md) before the entropy lemma and updated [lem-tgr-eckart-entropy-specialization](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/lem-tgr-eckart-entropy-specialization.md) to use it. The shear convention was cross-checked against [Gourgoulhon’s lecture notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0603009) and [Romatschke’s article](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0906.4787); the local proof establishes the required properties.

The existing static heat theorem and cosine example remain complete conditional arguments. The A/B pages, manifest, contracts, coverage, cross-batch evidence, notes, and Step 1 records are updated.

## Checks and readiness

Scoped proof-layout, precheck, strict contract, dependency, render, content-policy, coverage, and source-fetch checks pass. All five coverage source records are fetch-verified. Recomputed item levels are 0, 3, 4, and 5 for the shear lemma, entropy lemma, static theorem, and example.

The shear lemma is **ready**. The other three items are **escalated**: ET01 still lacks four planned page inputs, and MC02’s state, Gibbs–Euler, and frame readiness hashes are stale. Their exact interfaces and gaps are recorded in [batch-65 cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-65.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The shared batch-level dependency file is stale after the manifest edit. Recalculation confirms batch 65 remains at level 2 with suppliers 53, 55, and 62; I left the shared file for the owner-controlled refresh. Run-wide checks also report 54 empty scaffold inventories and 36 stale item-level labels outside batch 65; no batch-65 item has a level mismatch.
